ValidationRule.description: Override Order Number is required for SAP NA order type Customer return for a repair
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND (ISPICKVAL(Site__c, "Montreal"), ISPICKVAL( Order_Type__c , "Customer return for a repair"), NOT(ISNEW()), Override_Order_Number__c ='')
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Override Order Number is required for order type Customer return for a repair.
